propositions: Most core ticket, store, read/write, config, import/export, maintenance, and gate commands parse argv imperatively, creating duplicate grammar definitions between runtime handlers and docs-only argparse definitions.
Core Routes in _registry.py currently carry no parser_factory field (only advanced/intercept routes set it), requiring runtime handlers in _dispatch_* to perform manual grammar parsing.
Each migrated core command must preserve its family's unknown-token semantics (skip via parse_known_args vs reject-with-exit-2), which differ across command families and are not the argparse default.

Router-level global flag extraction for --output, --quiet, --allow-secret-pattern must run before per-command parser factories receive argv, and per-command factories must not re-declare these global flags.

All 49 core command handlers must route through a shared S2a argparse factory wired onto their Route.parser_factory, with no remaining parallel imperative grammar (excluding metrics, already migrated in S2c).
Parser construction must not import domain executors or optional dependencies, and a single selected execution must resolve no unrelated parser factory or handler.
